description: The figure presents two line plots comparing the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B under two different training regimes — “Easy Training Set” (top) and “Hard Training Set” (bottom) — across 500 training steps. In both plots, the x-axis represents “Steps,” ranging from 0 to 500 with major tick marks at intervals of 100, and the y-axis represents “Training Rewards,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and from 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot. In the top plot, the blue solid line with circular markers, labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy,” starts near 0.0 and rises steadily to approximately 0.38 by step 500, with a shaded region indicating variance. The red solid line with circular markers, labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy,” begins near 0.0, climbs more steeply early on, and reaches approximately 0.40 by step 500, also with a shaded variance region. In the bottom plot, the blue line “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” starts near 0.0, rises slightly to about 0.02 by step 50, then declines to near 0.0 for the remainder of training. The red line “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” begins near 0.0, increases gradually to about 0.10 by step 150, then fluctuates with a general upward trend, reaching approximately 0.20 by step 500, accompanied by a shaded variance region. Both plots include gridlines and legends positioned in the upper right corner.
